headline: OpenAI surges past Tencent; Meta's new model hits all-time high
summary: OpenAI clawed back 5.3 percentage points in a single day to claim second place at 15.9% token share, while Tencent's lead narrowed to 13.3%. Meta's fresh contributor model set an all-time record at 1.5% share on debut. Five new models entered the rankings, including OpenAI's gpt-6-astra and Qwen's latest pair.
highlights: OpenAI jumped +5.3% in daily token share, vaulting gpt-5.6-luna from rank 4 to rank 2
Tencent's hy4-preview still leads at 13.3%, but shed 2.9% in one day
Meta's muse-spark-1.3-contributor set an all-time token-share record at 1.5% on its first day

Five new entrants: openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903 (rank 31), qwen/qwen3.8-flash-20260826 (rank 48), qwen/qwen3.8-max-20260902 (rank 49), mistralai/mistral-nemo (rank 50), inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante-20260904:free (rank 51)
Five models dropped out, including qwen/qwen3.8-max-20260803 and openai/gpt-4o-mini
DeepSeek remains third at 18.1%, down 0.8% daily; Zhipu AI holds fourth at 14.1%
